title: Forward exchange/projection square without an outside Tate factor
statement:
Let l be prime, c a finite-extension or algebraic-closure coefficient index, k a field of prime characteristic p different from l, and Y any k-scheme. Use the maps of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pretrace-data], the pullback comparisons of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pull-comparison] and the native projection of [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition]. Write Lambda=(coefficient l c).X, q:P1_Y to Y, F=q*, R=Rq*, T=L_P[2], M=H(FK), and t:FK tensor T isomorphic M the tensorShiftIso. For every unbounded derived K on Y, the forward equality is
F(projection_q(K,T)) ; F(R(t.hom)) ; exchange_M = mu_q(K,RT)^(-1) ; (identity_FK tensor beta) ; D_K,
where beta and D_K are the fixed maps of the cited data node and mu_q is the canonical monoidal tensorator. No projection, exchange or twisted projection is assumed invertible; the only inverse displayed is a canonical tensor comparison. The exchange on H(FK) is written secondPretraceExchangeMap to retain the fixed endpoints; it is the native component itself.

source.place: Second identity: extraction of q*K and cancellation of the projection, before applying a trace.

proof.text: Apply ringed exchange/tensor coherence with inside T and outside K on the self-square of q. It identifies exchange after pulled projection with projection after exchange_T, retaining the tensor and pullback-composition comparisons.

Carry this equality through the internal-module/ringed equivalences. Their specified tensor, adjunction and composition clauses identify the actual module projection, actual mate exchange, and actual tensor comparison, not only their endpoints. Change from right-factor to left-factor order using the native symmetries.

Use naturality at tensorShiftIso.hom and at the first root-normalized line comparison. The target comparison is the inverse first pullTwistIso with the self-square comparison on K, hence exactly D_K; the other factor is beta. The q tensor comparison is inverse mu_q.

lean.statement:
theorem second_exchange_projection
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y)) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let F := moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
    let R := moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
    let T := ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) 0).obj
      (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    F.map (projectionMap Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) K T) ≫
        F.map (R.map (tensorShiftIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)
          (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) (F.obj K)).hom) ≫
        secondPretraceExchangeMap Λ Y
          ((twist Λ (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj (F.obj K)) =
      (secondTraceTensorIso Λ Y K (R.obj T)).inv ≫
        (F.obj K ◁ secondTraceExchange l c k p hpl Y) ≫
        secondExtractProjection l c k p hpl Y K
